/// The sum of [sizes].
int total(List<int> sizes) {
  var sum = 0;
  for (final size in sizes) {
    sum += size;
  }
  return sum;
}

/// Whether a job of [size] may be taken with the limit [limit].
bool fits(int size, int limit) => size >= 0 && size <= limit;

/// How many pages [lines] lines take with [perPage] on each.
int pages(int lines, int perPage) => (lines + perPage - 1) ~/ perPage;

/// [size] clamped [least] and [most].
int clamped(int size, int least, int most) =>
    size < least ? least : (size > most ? most : size);

/// The larger of [a] and [b]. No test asks which one it is when they are
/// equal.
int larger(int a, int b) => a >= b ? a : b;
